meta.dataset: FAO AQUASTAT Climate Information Tool reference ET0
meta.source: FAO AQUASTAT Climate Information Tool; CRU CL 2.0 gridded monthly climate, FAO-56 reference evapotranspiration
meta.spatialMethod: Nearest CRU grid-cell value returned for the centroid of the matched IMD district polygon; point climatology, not a district area average or current weather.
meta.notes: Reference climate normals only. For agricultural decision-making, compare with local station/field data. Missing or boundary-mismatched current districts remain unconfigured.
meta.monthValueMeaning: Long-term monthly reference ET0 normal; not observed current ET0 or today rainfall.
meta.recordProvenanceScope: The dataset-level source, sourcePeriod, units, datasetVersion, and verificationStatus apply to every monthly record. Each record contains state, district, month, et0MmMonth, and et0MmDay.
meta.spatialWarning: A district lookup returns the reference grid-cell value at the district centroid; it does not claim a station observation or district-wide area mean.
